summary: A small wooden tower with attached keeper's house at New London Bay, lit in 1876 and kept in the 1940s and 50s by Maisie Adams, PEI's only woman lightkeeper.

notes_for_editor: Fiscal years of the Marine reports are inferred from the corpus labels (volume numbers), not read off the title pages; check before publication. The keeper table in source 8 was matched by position in OCR. The 1894 fire is reported by Lighthouse Friends from the departmental report, which was not in the local corpus (pre-1900), so it is cited second-hand. The 1879 gale/front-range episode is single-sourced to Lighthouse Friends and the PEI society (same text). Maisie Adams's end date varies (1955-1959) and her pay figures differ between the PEI society pages ($13 vs $13.60 starting). Keeper dates for Pidgeon differ between sources. Source 5 (CRHP 11290) is cited only for federal heritage recognition of the rear range tower; 1991 designation year comes from our record, not read here. Source 7 text runs across pp. 37-38 (temporary back range light is on p. 38). McLeod's 29 Jan 1896 row in source 8 read from the OCR row (name and date on the same line).
